title: Understanding Regularization
text: Regularization is a technique used to prevent overfitting by adding a penalty to the model's complexity. It helps in simplifying the model and improving its generalization to new data.

title: L1 vs L2 Regularization
text: L1 regularization, also known as Lasso, tends to produce sparse models by driving some coefficients to zero. L2 regularization, or Ridge, tends to shrink coefficients but rarely makes them exactly zero.

title: High Dimensionality and Sparsity
text: In high-dimensional datasets, many features may not contribute significantly to the model's prediction. Regularization can help in identifying and reducing the impact of these less important features.
